facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health's NHMIS bulletin gives the national health facility reporting rate for the NHMIS Monthly Summary (Version 2019) on DHIS-2 as 91.5% for June 2025 (93.4, 93.1, 90.9, 92.1 and 91.4% for January to May), and charts the rate by facility type, primary, secondary and tertiary, and by public and private ownership; no numerator or denominator is given.
facts.system: National Health Management Information System (NHMIS), DHIS-2

facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health encourages states to continue to deploy mobile devices and computers for direct reporting to the DHIS-2, as more cost effective and better for data quality; it gives no count of facilities reporting directly.
facts.system: National Health Management Information System (NHMIS), DHIS-2

facts.fact: The NHMIS monthly bulletin of routine facility data (attendance, deliveries, immunisation, malaria cases, under-5 deaths) is issued by the Federal Ministry of Health, which also gives state HMIS officers access to its national platforms.
facts.system: National Health Management Information System (NHMIS), DHIS-2
